detail.instructions: In src/lib.rs, define a private TransferAmount(NonZeroU64) value and a TransferCommand whose private source, destination, and amount fields hold the validated data. Implement TryFrom<TransferRequest> so a same-account request or a zero amount is rejected with TransferRequestError, and add getters that expose the validated source, destination, and amount.

hints.body: A request only records what the caller asked for. Separate "the request was supplied" from "the request is legal to execute" with a second type that the ledger accepts.

NonZeroU64::new turns the zero check into a type invariant, and comparing the two account IDs rejects a self-transfer. Reject source == destination first, then build the command, and keep its fields private so no caller can skip the conversion.
The reference approach for this lesson.

detail.completionExplanation: TransferCommand is evidence that the request-only rules already passed, so the later phases can accept a command instead of rechecking the zero-amount and same-account cases. The private fields matter as much as the conversion: a validated type is only trustworthy when external code cannot forge it, and TryFrom<TransferRequest> is now the only way to obtain one.
